ABOUT THE PUBLICATION

Good ideas for the moments
that make us human.

Wishly Guide is an informational publication about relationships, thoughtful communication, emotional wellbeing, friendship, family, meaningful celebrations and personal digital expression. We turn common questions into practical, considerate guidance you can actually use.

RelationshipsEmotional wellbeingMeaningful momentsPractical tutorials

WHY WISHLY GUIDE EXISTS

A little more thought can make a big difference.

People often search for help with ordinary but important moments: what to say after an argument, how to make someone feel appreciated, how to support a friend, what to write in a birthday message or how to celebrate a relationship across distance.

Those questions deserve more than recycled one-line answers. They need context, examples and suggestions that respect the people involved. Wishly Guide brings those ideas together in one place, with clear explanations and practical steps.

Our aim is not to prescribe one perfect way to love, communicate or celebrate. Every person and relationship is different. We offer starting points that readers can adapt to their own circumstances, words and boundaries.

✦

OUR PURPOSE

Make thoughtful action easier.

Useful information should help you understand a situation, find words that sound like you and choose a considerate next step—without pressure to be perfect.

HOW TO USE THIS SITE

Start with your question.
Leave with a useful next step.

Wishly Guide is designed as a readable reference, not an account-based service. You can explore the information freely and follow the parts that are relevant to you.

01

Find the right topic

Browse the topic collections or search the guide library for a question such as how to apologise, what to write or how to plan a thoughtful surprise.

02

Read the context

Look beyond a quick script. Consider the other person's perspective, your shared history, timing, consent and what would feel natural in your situation.

03

Adapt the examples

Use sample messages and checklists as prompts, not words you must copy. Change them so the final message reflects your own voice and intentions.

04

Explore related ideas

Follow related guides for more context. When a personal webpage would help present a message or memory, learn about the separate Wishly product.

HOW THIS CONNECTS TO WISHLY

Wishly Guide explains ideas.
Wishly helps you express them.

Wishly and Wishly Guide are connected, but they serve different purposes. Wishly is the personal website creation product. Wishly Guide is the informational publication that shares ideas, tutorials and explanations related to meaningful moments and personal expression.

With Wishly, a person can start from an available template, personalise the parts supported by that template, review the page and share the published experience through a link. Depending on the template and available options, a page may include written messages, photos, visual styling and other media.

For example, someone planning a birthday surprise might first read our birthday website guide to organise a message and memories. They can then visit the main Wishly product if they decide a personal webpage is the right format for their idea.

Visit the main Wishly website ↗Learn how personal websites work

OUR EDITORIAL APPROACH

Helpful, respectful and clear.

Relationship and emotional topics deserve care. We aim to make the difference between a useful suggestion and a one-size-fits-all rule clear.

✦

Practical over vague

Guides aim to explain what a reader can consider doing, with context, examples, questions or checklists where useful.

♡

Respect over pressure

We avoid manipulative advice. Consent, boundaries, privacy and the freedom to say no matter more than getting a particular reaction.

⌕

Clear over exaggerated

We do not promise that a message will fix a relationship, guarantee a proposal response or make another person feel a certain way.

↻

Updated with care

Product explanations can change as Wishly changes. Readers can use the contact page to flag unclear, outdated or incorrect information.

About advice and wellbeing: Wishly Guide provides general educational and informational content. It is not a substitute for professional mental-health, medical, legal or other specialist support. If a situation involves immediate danger, abuse or a serious crisis, seek appropriate local professional or emergency help.
CREATOR & DEVELOPER

Read the developer profile ↗Visit portfolio ↗

THE PERSON BEHIND THE PROJECT

Built with a simple belief: technology can feel personal.

Wishly was created by RA Fahim, a web developer and creator interested in building useful digital experiences. The idea behind the product is straightforward: people should be able to present a personal message or memory online without first learning how to code a website.

Wishly Guide extends that idea through information. It brings together tutorials about the product and broader guidance on communication, relationships, celebrations and personal expression. The goal is to make the technology understandable while keeping the human reason for using it at the centre.

Learn more about the creator, the work behind Wishly and other projects on the developer profile or RA Fahim's portfolio.

TRANSPARENCY

What this publication is—and what it is not.

Wishly Guide is a static informational website. You can read its guides and topic pages without creating a Wishly account. It is not the Wishly website builder, a messaging service, a counselling platform or a place where readers submit private relationship conversations for us to resolve.

Some articles explain how a personal webpage may help present a letter, celebration or collection of memories. The choice to use a digital page is always optional. A sincere conversation, a handwritten note or a simple act of support may be more appropriate in many situations.

When using any online publishing tool, think carefully before sharing personal photos, names, contact details or private stories. Only share information and media that you have the right to use and that the people involved are comfortable making accessible.

ABOUT WISHLY GUIDE

A few things people often ask.

What is Wishly Guide?

Wishly Guide is an informational publication with practical articles about relationships, communication, emotional wellbeing, friendship, family, special occasions and personal digital expression. It also includes tutorials about the Wishly website creation product.

Is Wishly Guide the same as the main Wishly website?

No. Wishly is the product where people can create and share personal webpages using available templates. Wishly Guide is the information and learning site that explains ideas, answers questions and publishes tutorials.

Do I need an account to read Wishly Guide?

No account is required to read the informational articles and topic pages on Wishly Guide.

What subjects does Wishly Guide cover?

Coverage includes love and romance, relationship communication, emotional support, healthy boundaries, friendship, family appreciation, long-distance relationships, messages, birthdays, weddings, anniversaries and digital creativity.

Does Wishly Guide provide relationship or mental-health counselling?

No. The site offers general educational information and practical ideas. It is not a counselling service or a substitute for qualified professional support.

Who creates Wishly and Wishly Guide?

Wishly was created by web developer RA Fahim. You can read more about the creator and the work behind the project on the developer profile.

How can I report an error or suggest a topic?

Use the contact page to share a correction, report outdated product information or suggest a question that would make a useful future guide.
